scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B, RTX 4060 Laptop SM89, max_num_seqs=1, batch-1 greedy decode, vLLM fp8_per_block backbone
protocol: same patched source, C-S-S-C process order, fresh compile cache per process, six natural prompts, 128 output tokens, 3 warmups and 10 trials per case
candidate: per-row symmetric INT8 approximate scan plus exact BF16 top-128 shortlist rerank
limitations: The exact BF16 winner was observed inside the approximate top-128 shortlist for every measured step, but this is not a mathematical all-input guarantee.
Logits outside the shortlist are replaced by -inf, so full-logit, logprob and stochastic-sampling equivalence is not claimed.
The policy is not promoted for max_num_seqs greater than 1.
decision: PROMOTE as an empirically token-identical batch-1 greedy policy point; keep the exact full-vocabulary path as the strict fallback.
